metadata.question: Did Dry Chaco forest cover decrease by more than 10% between 2000 and 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use WWF Terrestrial Ecoregions (RESOLVE/ECOREGIONS/2017) to get the Dry Chaco geometry. Compute forest change using Hansen Global Forest Change 2023 v1.11. Compare forest area in 2000 vs 2019 within Dry Chaco.
2. Masking strategy: Use Hansen datamask to restrict to valid land data; no cloud masking needed.
3. Logic for validity: Check region found; check valid land pixels count; ensure 2000 forest area > 0; verify finite numeric results. If any fail, return C1/C2/C3 accordingly.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const eco = ee.FeatureCollection('RESOLVE/ECOREGIONS/2017');
    let dryChacoFC = eco.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ECO_NAME', 'Dry Chaco'));
    const nPrimary = await getInfoAsync(dryChacoFC.size());
    if (nPrimary === 0) {
      // Fallback: try contains 'Chaco' then re-filter to Dry Chaco if present
      const chacoAll = eco.filter(ee.Filter.stringContains('ECO_NAME', 'Chaco'));
      dryChacoFC = chacoAll.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ECO_NAME', 'Dry Chaco'));
    }
    const nRegion = await getInfoAsync(dryChacoFC.size());
    console.log(`Ecoregion features found: ${nRegion}`);
    if (!nRegion || nRegion === 0) {
      console.log('Region not found.');
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      return;
    }
    const region = dryChacoFC.union(1).geometry();

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Checks
    const gfc = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11');
    const land = gfc.select('datamask').eq(1);
    const landCountDict = land.updateMask(land).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e11,
      tileScale: 4
    });
    const landPx = await getInfoAsync(landCountDict.get('datamask'));
    console.log(`Valid land pixels (1km): ${landPx || 0}`);
    if (!landPx || landPx === 0) {
      console.log('No valid land pixels in region.');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    const threshold = 30; // percent canopy cover
    console.log(`Forest threshold (%): ${threshold}`);
    const tc2000 = gfc.select('treecover2000');
    const lossyear = gfc.select('lossyear'); // 1-23 => 2001-2023
    const lossLE2019 = lossyear.gt(0).and(lossyear.lte(19));
    const gain = gfc.select('gain').eq(1);

    const forest2000 = tc2000.gte(threshold).and(land);
    const survived2000to2019 = forest2000.and(lossLE2019.not());
    const gainNotLostBy2019 = gain.and(land).and(lossLE2019.not());
    const forest2019 = survived2000to2019.or(gainNotLostBy2019);

    const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea();

    const area2000 = await getInfoAsync(
      areaImg.updateMask(forest2000).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e11,
        tileScale: 4
      }).get('area')
    );
    const area2019 = await getInfoAsync(
      areaImg.updateMask(forest2019).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e11,
        tileScale: 4
      }).get('area')
    );
    const lossArea = await getInfoAsync(
      areaImg.updateMask(forest2000.and(lossLE2019)).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e11,
        tileScale: 4
      }).get('area')
    );
    const gainRetainedArea = await getInfoAsync(
      areaImg.updateMask(gainNotLostBy2019).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e11,
        tileScale: 4
      }).get('area')
    );

    // 4. Validation & Calculation
    if (area2000 == null || area2019 == null || lossArea == null || gainRetainedArea == null) {
      console.log('One or more area results are null.');
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }
    if (!isFinite(area2000) || !isFinite(area2019) || area2000 <= 0) {
      console.log(`Invalid baseline area: ${area2000}`);
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }

    const km2 = (m2) => m2 / 1e6;
    const mha = (m2) => m2 / 1e10; // 1 Mha = 10^6 ha = 10^10 m2

    const decreasePct = ((area2000 - area2019) / area2000) * 100;

    // 5. Evidence output (concise)
    const regionAreaKm2 = await getInfoAsync(
      areaImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 3000,
        maxPixels: 1e11,
        tileScale: 4
      }).get('area')
    );
    console.log(`Region area (km2): ${km2(regionAreaKm2).toFixed(0)}`);
    console.log(`Forest2000 (Mha): ${mha(area2000).toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Loss to 2019 (Mha): ${mha(lossArea).toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Gain 2000-2012 retained by 2019 (Mha): ${mha(gainRetainedArea).toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Forest2019 (Mha): ${mha(area2019).toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Decrease (%): ${decreasePct.toFixed(2)}`);

    // 6. Final Answer
    const answer = decreasePct > 10 ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
